description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class 'DirectoryTest' for testing the sorting functionality of the 'Directory' class within the 'Todaymade\Daux\Tree' namespace. It defines a data provider 'providerSort' supplying various test cases and a test method 'testSort' that verifies the sorting logic of directory entries based on specific naming conventions.

classes.name: DirectoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the sorting behavior of directory entries in the 'Todaymade\Daux\Tree' namespace.

methods.name: providerSort
methods.description: Data provider method that supplies pairs of unsorted and correctly sorted directory entry names for testing.

methods.name: testSort
methods.description: Test method that shuffles the input list, applies the sorting algorithm, and asserts the directory entries are sorted as expected.
